hero.headline: Applied Intelligence
hero.supportingText: A connected ecosystem of specialized agents built to improve reporting, traceability, communication, quoting, corrective flow, and business-value visibility.

featured.title: AI-Connect
featured.description: The connective operating layer that ties people, departments, reports, meetings, permissions, and handoffs together so nothing important gets lost.

sections.title: One ecosystem. Separate agents. Clear roles.
sections.body: Applied Intelligence is designed as a family of specialist agents connected through shared source files and coordinated through AI-Connect.

sections.title: Specialized agents, built to stay in role.
sections.body: Each agent owns a specific function so the ecosystem stays structured, scalable, and clear.
